name: 95391 · Mtn House, CA
findings: ZIP 95391 (Mtn House) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 11 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95391 (Mtn House) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
